title: HECM Line Designation and Draw Requests Still in the Queue
content:
**Rule.** Added to the amounts kept when the designated amount of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan is set are the draw requests already queued on the loan, meaning its draw requests whose request status is submitted.

| Channels of the queued draw requests | Amount held |
|---|---|
| at least one came through the servicing portal or a signed written form | the full total of every queued draw request |
| every one came by phone | their total, but no more than the plan's phone draw figure (15000.00 on the HECM Line of Credit, the HECM Modified Tenure Plan and the HECM Modified Term Plan; 0.00 on plans without draws) |
| no queued draw request | nothing |

*Hypothetical cases (15000.00 phone figure):* a single signed written request for 2500.00 and a phone request for 1000.00 hold 3500.00; three phone requests of 6000.00 each hold 15000.00; a draw request already processed holds nothing.
